Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical geographical error by incorrectly classifying Da Nang as being in the Mekong Delta region. Da Nang is located in the South Central Coast region of Vietnam, whereas An Phu is in the Mekong Delta. The Planner failed to verify the regional classification of Da Nang against established geographical facts, leading to the false conclusion that both locations are in the same region.
